import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int B = 1_000_000;
    static final int MOD1 = 998244353;
    static final int MOD2 = 1_000_000_007;
    static long N, counter, total;
    static List<Integer>[] vec = new ArrayList[10];
    static int[] prefixSum = new int[10];
    static int result;
    
    static int calc(long x) {
        return (int)((x % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1);
    }
    
    static void dfs1(int depth, long num) {
        ++counter;
        vec[depth].add(calc(counter - num));
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; ++digit) {
            dfs1(depth + 1, num * 10 + digit);
        }
    }
    
    static void dfs2(int depth, long num) {
        if (num > N) return;
        if (depth >= 1) {
            if (num * B > N / 10 && (num + 1) * B <= N + 1) {
                long tmp = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i, tmp *= 10) {
                    int w = calc(counter - tmp * num);
                    int target = MOD1 - w;
                    List<Integer> list = vec[i];
                    int pos = Collections.binarySearch(list, target);
                    if (pos < 0) pos = -pos - 1;
                    else {
                        while (pos > 0 && list.get(pos-1) == target) pos--;
                    }
                    long add = (1L * w * list.size() + prefixSum[i] - 1L * MOD1 * (list.size() - pos));
                    add %= MOD2;
                    if (add < 0) add += MOD2;
                    result = (int)((result + add) % MOD2);
                }
                counter += total;
                return;
            }
            ++counter;
            result = (result + calc(counter - num)) % MOD2;
        }
        int startDigit = (depth == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        for (int digit = startDigit; digit < 10; ++digit) {
            dfs2(depth + 1, num * 10 + digit);
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        sc.close();
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            vec[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(vec[i]);
            long sum = 0;
            for (int v : vec[i]) sum += v;
            prefixSum[i] = (int)(sum % MOD2);
        }
        total = counter;
        counter = 0;
        result = 0;
        dfs2(0, 0);
        System.out.println((result + MOD2) % MOD2);
    }
}
